name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 28, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Julia Hemenez, Member of the Community
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of the Fair Housing Poster Contest Winner Awards.
P2.
Proclamation declaring May 3, 2009, "Friends of the Rancho Buena Vista Adobe Day" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Presentation of Certificate of Appointment to incoming Parks and Recreation Commissioner Debbie Piper.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Second Reading of Ordinance (BSD)
C4.
Cabaret License Application for the Jumping Bean Café located at 785 Shadowridge Drive (CC)
C5.
Failure to Display Disabled Placard Administrative Fee (CC)
C6.
Quitclaim Access Rights for Hotel Driveway at 2645 S. Melrose Drive (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Quitclaim Deed of Access Rights along a portion of the property; and
2.
Authorize the City Clerk to record the deed in the Office of the San Diego County Recorder upon its approval and execution.
C7.
Agreement for Downtown Specific Plan Program Environmental Impact Report (EIR) (CDC)
C8.
Solid Waste Collection and Disposal Rates (CC)
C9.
Agua Hedionda Watershed Management Plan (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Vista Conservancy Trail through Sycamore Creek Property (CDC)
D2.
Cities for Climate Protection Campaign (CC)
D3.
Third Quarter Financial Report for Fiscal Year 2008/2009 (CC)
1.
Receive the report; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Operating Program Budget.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Recreation and Community Services Fees (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending Recreation and Community Service Fees.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
